# Rotten Tomatoes Editorial

> > Editorial content from Rotten Tomatoes covering critical consensus roundups, home video releases, box office analysis, and film reviews with Tomatometer scores.

This is the editorial arm of Rotten Tomatoes, featuring weekly critical consensus articles that aggregate professional film reviews, comprehensive DVD/Blu-ray release coverage including Criterion Collection titles, and box office performance tracking. The content spans theatrical releases and home video across all genres, with a focus on helping audiences discover films through aggregated critical opinion.

## Key Topics

- Tomatometer scores
- Critical consensus
- DVD and Blu-ray releases
- Home video coverage
- Weekend box office
- Movie reviews
- Criterion Collection
- New theatrical releases
- Action films
- Comedy films
- Romantic comedy
- Weekly film roundups
- 2005-2006 releases
- Film criticism aggregation

## Box Office & Current Releases

- [Weekend Box Office](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/weekend-box-office): Current weekend box office results and film earnings analysis

## Critical Consensus - Weekly Theatrical Reviews

- [Critical Consensus: "Crank" Is Well-Ranked; "Illusionist" Is Magic, "Crossover" Is An Air-Ball, "Wicker Man" Gets Burned](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/Critical-Consensus-Crank-Is-Well-Ranked-Illusionist-Is-Magic-Crossover-Is-An-Air-Ball-Wicker-Man-Gets-Burned): Weekly theatrical roundup: Statham's Crank, Norton's Illusionist reviewed
- [Critical Consensus: "Domino" Topples, "Elizabethtown" Disappoints](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/Critical-Consensus-Domino-Topples-Elizabethtown-Disappoints): Weekly theatrical reviews: Domino Harvey biopic & Cameron Crowe's romance
- [Critical Consensus: "Jackass" Kicks; "King" Is Dethroned; "Fearless" Is Action-Packed; "Flyboys" Is Grounded](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/Critical-Consensus-Jackass-Kicks-King-Is-Dethroned-Fearless-Is-Action-Packed-Flyboys-Is-Grounded): Weekly roundup: Jackass 2, Sean Penn's King's Men & Jet Li's Fearless
- [Critical Consensus: 'Tis Not The "Season," "Guardian" Lacks Defenders, And "School" Flunks](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/Critical-Consensus-Tis-Not-The-Season-Guardian-Lacks-Defenders-And-School-Flunks): Theatrical reviews: Open Season animation, Coast Guard drama & comedy roundup
- [Critical Consensus: "Dead Man's Chest" Is Overstuffed; "Scanner" Shines Darkly](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/critical-consensus-dead-mans-chest-is-overstuffed-scanner-shines-darkly): Pirates of the Caribbean sequel & A Scanner Darkly critical reviews
- [RT Critical Consensus: "Doom" Gloom, "Country" Sounds Sweet](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/RT-Critical-Consensus-Doom-Gloom-Country-Sounds-Sweet): Weekly reviews: Video game adaptation Doom & drama North Country
- [Critical Consensus: Rush Hour 3 Runs On Fumes; Stardust Shines; Daddy Day Camp Is Laugh-Free](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/Critical-Consensus-Rush-Hour-3-Runs-On-Fumes-Stardust-Shines-Daddy-Day-Camp-Is-Laugh-Free): Weekly roundup: Jackie Chan's Rush Hour 3 & fantasy film Stardust reviews

## DVD & Blu-ray Release Coverage

- [RT on DVD & Blu-Ray: Thor and Star Wars: The Complete Saga](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/RT-on-DVD-and-Blu-Ray-Thor-and-Star-Wars-The-Complete-Saga): Major releases: Marvel's Thor, Star Wars Complete Saga & Citizen Kane Blu-rays
- [RT on DVD & Blu-Ray: Lincoln and Killing Them Softly](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/rt-on-dvd-and-blu-ray-lincoln-and-killing-them-softly): Home video roundup: Spielberg's Lincoln and Criterion Collection reissues

- [RT on DVD: The Hangover, The Proposal, Glee](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/RT-on-DVD-The-Hangover-The-Proposal-Glee): DVD releases: Comedy hits The Hangover & The Proposal plus Glee pilot

- [RT on DVD & Blu-Ray: Hyde Park on Hudson](https://editorial.rottentomatoes.com/article/rt-on-dvd-and-blu-ray-hyde-park-on-hudson): Home video: Bill Murray's FDR biopic & Criterion Collection releases
